source_ref: OSF dqw9f (public node; API reports no node licence): Supplemental Studies/Study S1a Data and Code/Study S1a Data.sav (https://osf.io/download/5p78v/, sha256 ceefe3a63ccdf3da75a45c16b8097517085cf64453f9fb2b8118646534503f33) and Study S1b Data.sav (https://osf.io/download/8j3em/, sha256 55f1616c3ea6963bdefea6e9826218115daf29f09191d7f1497ddeab18e6e7ea) -- SPSS variable and value labels of practices_MCM, values1_MCM, bemyself_MCM, effort1_MCM, colleagues_MCM, effort2_MCM, supervisor_MCM, management_MCM, values2_MCM, environment_MCM; data/wallace_2026_mindsets.py (_CULTURE, mcm_culture.csv spec) for the code derivation. Paper: Wallace, Murphy, Hernandez-Colmenares & Fujita (2026) JPSP 130(2) 291-307, doi:10.1037/pspi0000498.
note: Level 1, both label levels read in the S1a and S1b .sav files (copied from the batch_655 wallace_2026_mcm_check cache; full sha256s match its record; the other five studies' .sav files carry none of these ten columns). CODE DERIVATION (data/wallace_2026_mindsets.py, mcm_culture.csv spec: (c, c, None, 0) for c in _CULTURE, studies s1a/s1b only): item IS the source column name, no rename and no recode (no '-' prefix), so exempt from Step 5b and no verification files. Live: 6200 rows, 10 items x 620 (cov_study 2 = S1a 2380 rows, cov_study 3 = S1b 3820 rows), resp 1-7, no itemcov_* columns. Route 9 corroboration: all 20 study x item count vectors (resp 1..7) source = live exactly (0 mismatches), e.g. S1a practices_MCM 65/36/31/41/28/22/15, S1b values2_MCM 83/79/58/53/50/35/24. WORDING: the ten variable labels are character-identical in S1a and S1b (both name MCM Consulting, consistent with batch_655's finding that S1* = MCM), so item_text is the label verbatim with no study prefix. No line breaks or numbering in these labels; bemyself_MCM's straight double quotes kept as in the source. No instructions or lead-in in any label; instructions left blank. ANCHOR DIRECTION: every item in both files has value labels 1='1 - Strongly agree', 2..6 bare digits, 7='7 - Strongly disagree' (identical label sets, asserted in the build script). Corroborated against the data: all ten items correlate +0.61..+0.89 with interestwork_MCM ('I think I would like to work at a place like MCM Consulting.', same 1 = Strongly agree anchors) and +0.61..+0.91 with each other (no reverse-keyed item); mean over the ten items is lower in the growth condition (Mindset=+1) than the fixed condition (S1a 2.79 vs 3.81, S1b 2.67 vs 3.52), i.e. more agreement with the growth-culture organization, the paper's premise. Nothing runs the other way. OPTIONS: resp 1 = 'Strongly agree', 7 = 'Strongly disagree' ('1 - '/'7 - ' prefixes stripped, as prior wallace rounds); 2-6 left blank (bare digits in the source, not padded). Every item's respondents used all 7 levels in both studies. Rights: study-authored battery about a fictitious organization; some items echo published fit/commitment wording (effort2 resembles an OCQ item of Mowday, Steers & Porter 1979; values2 resembles person-organization fit items of the Cable & Judge line). No fee, permission, NC or redistribution clause located for any of them -- silence = permission. Not in instrument_rights_register.csv; no register row written.
public_note: Responses run 1 = Strongly agree to 7 = Strongly disagree, so a higher value means less agreement with the statement; the items refer to the fictitious organization MCM Consulting described to participants in Studies S1a and S1b (cov_study = 2, 3).
